fusions.name: Tether Tap
fusions.desc: Strikes a target up to 5 tiles away for 4 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, with a 30% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Silk Lure
fusions.desc: Casts a sticky bolt that deals 10 damage and makes the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Still Water
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Web of Wake
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.
